company.name: Poultry Sync
company.shortDescription: Poultry Sync is an AI-powered genetics-to-table platform that helps poultry farmers increase earnings while adhering to safety laws.
company.description:
PoultrySync is a technology-driven poultry management platform focused on transforming modern poultry farming through smart, integrated digital solutions. The company helps poultry businesses improve productivity, operational efficiency, and sustainability by combining advanced technology with practical farm management expertise.
PoultrySync offers solutions designed to streamline poultry operations, enabling farmers and poultry enterprises to monitor performance, optimize resource utilization, and make data-informed decisions. By leveraging innovation and industry insights, the platform supports better flock management, operational transparency, and overall business growth.
Committed to advancing the poultry sector, PoultrySync also serves as a knowledge-sharing hub where industry professionals can stay informed about emerging trends, technological advancements, and best practices in poultry farming. Through its growing network of experts, partners, and poultry leaders, the company aims to foster collaboration and drive smarter, more sustainable poultry production.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $200,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $80,000, representing 28.57% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,504,927 to $5,028,408, a 1.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
